name: @peersyst/fiber-lsp-sdk-e2e-agent
description: The device of fiber's hosted-LSP e2e suites, run by the SDK behind the control contract of fiber's own test agent.

scripts.test: rm -rf dist/test dist/scenarios && tsc && node --test dist/test/*.spec.js
scripts.scenarios: rm -rf dist/test dist/scenarios && tsc && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/scenarios/*.scenario.js
